title: Skill definition
description: Skills are data referencing shared behavior/animation primitives on the base rigs (canon §3). Used by classes, creatures, Bestial Skill drops, and pet skill pools.

behavior.description: Which sim behavior primitive executes this skill

numbers.description: Behavior-specific tunables (damage_coeff, reach_m, arc_deg, projectile_speed_mps, cooldown_s, windup_ticks, active_ticks, recovery_ticks, field_radius_m, field_duration_s...). Server-readable for hotfixes (canon §7).

applies_field.description: Elemental field id this skill lays on the tile grid, if any (e.g. core.field.fire) — field combos per canon §4

telegraph.description: Readability contract: hard attacks telegraph clearly (boss canon)
